notes.title: Working on Multiplayer Modes
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Brick-Breaker Fans![/b][/p][p]I’ve been working hard on [i]Rogue Bricks[/i], and i have some some big news. [b]multiplayer is coming to the game![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This won’t be a stripped-down version, [b]all the features of the main game will be fully included in multiplayer[/b]:[/p][p]Leveling up, Score and combos, Coins and shop, Equipment system (Stars Shards and Mods)[/p][p]I’ve put a lot of thought into how multiplayer should play. A simple co-op mode with two ships at the bottom felt too basic, not exciting or fresh enough. 

So instead, I’m developing a [b]Versus Mode[/b]:
[/p][p][b]One ship on the bottom, one on the top[/b] [/p][p][b]Each player has their own ball (or balls) [/b][/p][p][b]Bouncing your opponent’s balls turns them into your own [/b][/p][p][b]Your balls drop loot for you ; their balls drop loot for them[/b][/p][p][b]Outplay your opponent, rack up combos, level up faster, earn more gold, and dominate![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Multiplayer will support the following setups[/b]:
 Same keyboard
 1 keyboard + 1 mouse
 Same gamepad – one player per stick
 Steam Deck – two players on one device
 2 gamepads – two players
 Remote play with Steam Remote Play Together
[/p][p]My goal is to make [i]Rogue Bricks[/i] the [b]best brick-breaker ever made[/b]. Please share the game with your friends and leave your feedback on the forums — it means a lot!
[/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting [i]Rogue Bricks[/i]!


I’m also working on an entirely new type of multiplayer game — but that’s still a ways off. Please check it out:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798950/Buff_Climbers/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Big Update - Rogue Bricks
notes.notes:
I have been working on this update for about a month. A lot have been added. Check it out:

- Equipment system for your ships.
- Find mods and buy them in-game to carry them over to your permanent inventory
- Find very rare Star Shards. They can be equipped just like ship mods.
- Complete rework of the sound system. More satisfying soundscape.
- Complete rework of the Game Over and rewards screen.
- New perks
- New powerups
- New mutators
- New Enemies
- Enemy AI reworked significantly
- Bosses gained new attacks
- A new ship: Reflex
- New achievements
- Many visual improvements
- Bug fixes and stability improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.2 arrived!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing [b]Rogue Bricks[/b].
Version [b]1.2[/b] is here. 
A lot have been added & changed. 

- [b]Aim Arena[/b] completely redone. Have fun & earn rewards while learning the ropes. 65+ handcrafted levels from easy to "is this even possible". Also get ranked on leaderboards and earn achievements.

- [b]Idle mode[/b]. New perks unique to the idle clicker mode. This mode is a different kind of fun. Discover the changes. Mouse or Touch Screen Required.

- [b]Curved balls[/b]. New game mechanic centered around curved balls. Give curvature to your balls by hitting them while moving fast. Add new properties by picking perks specific to your play style.

- [b]New hidden special stages[/b]. Throwbacks to old childhood favorites. Don't underestimate these levels, they are hard.

- [b]New perks[/b]. Go unlock them

- [b]Autosave system[/b]. A run can take up to two hours. Let's be on the safe side

- Visual upgrades

- D-Pad control added. You can use the A button to slow your ship down for more precise shot.

- Balancing. Mostly buffs, because no one likes nerfs.

- Many bug fixes and translation

[b]join me on Discord[/b]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/8D8bh9cq]https://discord.gg/Xyr3zu7m[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is here
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Update [b]1.1[/b] is here. Goal of this update is to make game more fun for everybody.

- [b]Added Easy Mode. [/b]

This mode is for players looking for a more relaxed, not very punishing gameplay. All the usual perks and powerups can be unlocked. Coin, Gem and Gift drops are same as in Classic mode. Available from the start, you do not need to unlock. 

- [b]Hyper mode[/b]

Just the opposite of Easy mode. This mode is for players looking to play 10 minutes of extreme action and chaos. You levelup faster but so does the enemy. Every upgrade you do must matter if you wish to survive. Available from the start, you do not need to unlock. 

-[b] New boost pads[/b]: to increase the randomness of the battlefield, i have added new boost pads. Some are helpful, some are of questionable help.

- [b]Score System[/b]: A completely new scoring system. Rack up big combos to score high. 

- [b]Score Leaderboard:[/b] A global leaderboard keeps track of everyone's high scores. Let's see who will break 1,000,000 points first.


Others:
- Combo Gold Rain: Combo count above X10 start raining down gold. You have so many reasons not to break your combo.
- Visual Improvements
- Music Arrangement Changes (some slow music was wrongly playing during high octane moments)
- Balance Fixes
- Translation fixes


Thank you for playing my game.
More updates will follow soon

P.S.
I need your feedback! please use the Steam Discussion Boards

notes.title: Game Released! What now?
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you, everyone, for being interested in my game.[/b]

[b]Rogue Bricks has officially gone gold![/b]

You can buy it at [b]20% off[/b] until the end of the Spring Sale.

But wait! Release does not mean I'm done with it!

Here are some of my future plans for the game:

   -In the next few updates, I will continue adding new perks, power-ups, and special stages to the game.
Balancing a roguelike game takes quite a bit of effort. Not every power-up I added made the game more interesting—I had to remove some of them. If you have any ideas for new power-ups, please post them on the discussion forums!

-Aim Arena currently has only three sections. I scrapped the others because they weren’t fun. I left the first three as a way to teach players how to aim the ball. Aim Arena will eventually become a challenge gauntlet where I add my most difficult handcrafted levels. Look forward to it!

-Easy Mode is currently disabled. I found it too slow and not fun. I will think of ways to make it enjoyable.

-[b]I need your feedback![/b] Is the game too hard? Too chaotic? Or a piece of cake? Or worse boring :( Please leave a review or post on the Steam Discussion Board.

Thank you very much,
mikbal
